title: evidence-re (v2.10)
description: Refusal Evidence. Issued by RDP(in) when the recipient explicitly declines the message.

event.description: ETSI EN 319 522-1 clause 6 event (component G03). RE-v1 attests C.4 ConsignmentRejection (the recipient, upon proper authentication, rejected the user content).

reason.description: X-25: the value space is REGISTRY-GOVERNED, not spec-versioned — the schema bounds only the LEXICAL form (lowercase-kebab; x- = private use, never registered). The registered set and its event bindings live in registries/reason-codes.json (umbrella §13.4); registering a code is a registry action, NOT a version bump (§9.3). An unregistered well-formed code is accepted, preserved verbatim and treated generically (LINT-NDE-W1).

refusal_kind.description: X-29 (evidence 2.3): WHO refused. 'member' = an individual recipient member's act — REQUIRES mid, auth_context and a recipient-produced refusal_confirmation, reason MUST be refused-by-user; 'organisation-policy' = the published policy refused — REQUIRES acceptance_policy_ref, no user action is claimed or implied, reason is one of the policy grounds. An RDP-only assertion claiming a user act (refused-by-user without member proof) is rejected (LINT-RE-01). TODO(legal): the respective Article 43(2) weight of the two kinds awaits counsel.
